method.title: Use real client resources first
method.detail: This batch repurposes existing client photography. AI imagery is reserved for a documented lack of suitable resources and must be realistic, labelled and reviewed.

method.title: Start with the actual subject
method.detail: The actual plate, cake board, shop pack or room supplies the distinctive detail. Source photographs and original logos remain separate from editable graphic layers.

method.title: Build a coherent composition
method.detail: Match the crop and reading path to existing light, perspective and depth. A close contact shadow grounds a subject; avoid adding a shadow when the photograph already supplies it.

method.title: Blend only where the source allows
method.detail: Use reversible masks at quiet image edges, or full-bleed crops where fine glass/pack edges cannot be extracted faithfully. Keep the product recognisable.

method.title: Give the headline genuine space
method.detail: Use one short headline in a quiet part of the image. Local readability overlays may darken displayed tones; they must not conceal essential product details.

method.title: Review the exported artwork
method.detail: Inspect the actual subject, typography, logo, crop and phone-size readability. These are drafts for team review, with no promised reach or virality.
